articles.title: Morning Minute: AI Agents Cut BTC Quantum Attack Benchmark by 86%
articles.snippet: Crypto majors are shaky ahead of this morning’s CPI print, but onchain is heating up for another big potential weekend.

articles.title: AI Agents Just Slashed the Cost of a Quantum Attack on Bitcoin
articles.snippet: The ECDSA.Fail challenge cut a resource benchmark for one component of a potential quantum attack by 86%.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin Pushes Ethereum Plan to Slash Quantum-Safe Privacy Costs
articles.snippet: Buterin wants EIP-8288 in I-star, the upgrade after Hegota, and adopting it would make RISC-V Ethereum's canonical instruction set.

articles.title: While Bitcoin Devs Debate Next Moves, IonQ Unveils Superion 256 Quantum Computer
articles.snippet: The company has built its first chips and begun testing prototypes as it seeks to manufacture quantum computers in larger quantities.
